items.name: mountains
items.prompt:
Use case: style-transfer. Asset type: a horizontal 3:1 winter panorama for a slowly moving train-window view in a mobile app. Input image 1 is the landscape variation target; image 2 is only the cabin style/color reference. Replace the outdoor environment of image 1 with the scene described below while retaining the exact soft low-poly, slightly voxel-like painted 3D style, snowy material, muted indigo/violet/blue palette and cozy toy proportions. Wide landscape 3:1 composition, horizon around the middle, readable subjects through a small window crop anywhere across the width. Similar horizon, color and foreground height at both left/right edges so a slow repeating horizontal pan has no obvious hard seam. Full bleed scenery only. No train, tracks in the foreground, windows, frames, interior, foreground glass reflections, UI, lettering, logos, people, labels, watermark or collage. Do not copy the forest composition: this must be a clearly different place. Snowy twilight/night with restrained warm accents only where natural.
Scene: Broad snowy alpine peaks with faceted indigo silhouettes, a deep valley and a few small snow-laden firs in the foreground. Pale violet dusk sky, crisp snow ridges. Mountain range is the main subject; no lake or village.
